source_article_family_followup.source_scope: RCSB full-text DOI/title family follow-up for related ATR-ATRIP publication rows.

evidence_against: RCSB core entry still reports the primary citation as To Be Published with no article DOI, PubMed ID, or year.
PDBe publications endpoint still reports type U / To be published with no DOI, PubMed ID, or year.
Europe PMC exact and alias queries returned no publication-metadata hit for the 23FC title or ATR-ATRIP/Chk1 ATPgammaS aliases.
Crossref only yielded the wwPDB dataset DOI for the exact 23FC title; no article/preprint DOI matching ATR/Chk1 was found in the bounded top rows.
RCSB full-text sibling aliases still return only 23FC.
Crossref related PDB-dataset follow-up found donor-state sibling(s) without a named Chk1/substrate entity: 5YZ0, 9L4F.
Single-article DOI/title family follow-up reviewed related ATR-ATRIP rows with no named substrate entity: 5YZ0, 9L40, 9L43, 9L45, 9L46, 9L4B, 9L4C, 9L4D, 9L4F.

Transient geometry scan of the same article family found zero local-metal non-peptide substrate candidates; status counts: {"donor_or_analog_without_heteromeric_acceptor_review_only": 2, "no_active_donor_or_transition_analog_review_only": 7}.
evidence_for: PDBe independently confirms the same 23FC title, release date, deposition authors, hetero hexamer assembly, and associated EMDB map.
Crossref confirms the PDB dataset DOI 10.2210/pdb23fc/pdb for the deposited structure, but that is not article source authority.
Crossref also exposed related ATR-ATRIP ATPgammaS dataset(s) with article metadata, useful as source-published donor-only negatives: 5YZ0, 9L4F.
The related ATR-ATRIP source article maps to a compact PDB family for review-only negative context: 5YZ0, 9L40, 9L43, 9L45, 9L46, 9L4B, 9L4C, 9L4D, 9L4F.
source_review_summary.recommendation: Keep 23FC review-only as PIKK/short-segment stress evidence. Do not treat the PDB dataset DOI as publication/source authority for clean ePK positive evidence; wait for article metadata or new non-peptide canonical ePK exact-ligand rows.
